scripts.check: bun run --cwd apps/web check && bun run --cwd apps/extension check && bun run --cwd packages/domain check && bun run --cwd packages/fill-engine check && bun run --cwd packages/utils check
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/extension test && bun run --cwd packages/domain test && bun run --cwd packages/fill-engine test && bun run --cwd packages/utils test
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/extension build && bun run --cwd packages/domain build && bun run --cwd packages/fill-engine build && bun run --cwd packages/utils build
scripts.ready: bun run fmt && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,convex -c blue,magenta "bun run --cwd apps/web dev -- --port 3676" "bunx convex dev"
scripts.dev:tailscale: concurrently -n web,convex -c blue,magenta "bun run --cwd apps/web dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3676" "bunx convex dev"
